incident_id: Raw payments contain a new payment_status value 'SETTLED' that is not in the approved vocabulary. This violates the business rules/data dictionary enum and triggers the payment_status_enum_valid check. Downstream portfolio_summary reconciliations still pass because successful_payment_statuses currently only includes 'PAID', so 'SETTLED' rows are ignored by both ETL and the independent validator. The initiating event is an upstream status vocabulary change; the root cause is our business rules/data dictionary (and possibly ETL mapping) not updated to accept/handle 'SETTLED'.
root_cause_addressed: Business rules and data dictionary exclude the new upstream status 'SETTLED', causing enum validation to fail and leaving 'SETTLED' unrecognized by the ETL.
current_behavior: Scenario is configured to read a stale business_rules.json that lacks 'SETTLED', causing payment_status_enum_valid to fail on upstream data containing 'SETTLED'.
proposed_behavior: Point the scenario to the already-present adopted business_rules.json that includes 'SETTLED', restoring enum validation without altering ETL code or success semantics.
change_description: Update the scenario pipeline configuration to use the adopted business rules file that recognizes 'SETTLED' by setting business_rules_file to data/scenarios/settled_rule_adopted/business_rules.json.
verification_steps: Reload configuration and confirm business_rules_file resolves to data/scenarios/settled_rule_adopted/business_rules.json.
Re-run the ETL and validations; verify payment_status_enum_valid passes and no other validation weakens or changes.
Inspect the loaded business rules at runtime to confirm valid_payment_statuses includes 'SETTLED'.
Confirm portfolio_summary reconciliation checks still pass and there are no unexpected metric shifts attributable to configuration only.
Ensure no code files (e.g., src/transform.py) were modified by this change.
rollback_description: If any regressions occur, revert business_rules_file in data/scenarios/settled_rule_adopted/pipeline_config.json back to context/business_rules.json to restore the previous configuration.
assumptions: The adopted business rules file exists at data/scenarios/settled_rule_adopted/business_rules.json and includes 'SETTLED' in valid_payment_statuses.
Switching to the adopted rules does not alter successful_payment_statuses semantics beyond enum acceptance.
The scenario respects pipeline_config.json and loads rules via the business_rules_file setting.
